1: // Simple Meteor Dodge game targeting canvas with id="game"
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5:   const width = canvas.width;
6:   const height = canvas.height;
7: 
8:   // Ship configuration
9:   const ship = {
10:     x: width / 2,
11:     y: height - 30,
12:     radius: 15,
13:     speed: 4,
14:     dx: 0,
15:     dy: 0,
16:   };
17: 
18:   // Input handling
19:   const keys = {};
20:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => (keys[e.key] = true));
21:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => (keys[e.key] = false));
22: 
23:   // Meteor class
24:   class Meteor {
25:     constructor() {
26:       this.reset();
27:     }
28:     reset() {
29:       this.x = Math.random() * width;
30:       this.y = -20; // start above canvas
31:       const angle = (Math.random() * Math.PI) / 3 - Math.PI / 6; // -30° to +30°
32:       const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3; // 2-5 px/frame
33:       this.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
34:       this.vy = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
35:       this.radius = 10 + Math.random() * 10; // 10-20
36:     }
37:     update() {
38:       this.x += this.vx;
39:       this.y += this.vy;
40:       if (this.y - this.radius > height || this.x < -this.radius || this.x > width + this.radius) {
41:         this.reset();
42:       }
43:     }
44:     draw() {
45:       ctx.beginPath();
46:       ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
47:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
48:       ctx.fill();
49:     }
50:   }
51: 
52:   const meteors = [];
53:   const METEOR_COUNT = 5;
54:   for (let i = 0; i < METEOR_COUNT; i++) meteors.push(new Meteor());
55: 
56:   let startTime = performance.now();
57:   let gameOver = false;
58: 
59:   function updateShip() {
60:     ship.dx = 0;
61:     ship.dy = 0;
62:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
63:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.dx = ship.speed;
64:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
65:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.dy = ship.speed;
66:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(width - ship.radius, ship.x + ship.dx));
67:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(height - ship.radius, ship.y + ship.dy));
68:   }
69: 
70:   function drawShip() {
71:     ctx.beginPath();
72:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
73:     ctx.arc(ship.x, ship.y, ship.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
74:     ctx.fill();
75:   }
76: 
77:   function checkCollision() {
78:     for (const m of meteors) {
79:       const dx = m.x - ship.x;
80:       const dy = m.y - ship.y;
81:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
82:       if (dist < m.radius + ship.radius) {
83:         gameOver = true;
84:         break;
85:       }
86:     }
87:   }
88: 
89:   function drawScore() {

91:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
